claim.value: Foy contrasts Frère’s 3,000 combatants with the 6,000 who had failed against Valencia; side A assault-population alternative.
claim.rationale: Retrospective contrast, not a dated return or a correction to Napoleon’s broader estimate. English rendering (ours): "He could not hope to take, with three thousand combatants, a city against which six thousand had just failed."
